notes.subject: cast words behind you
notes.rationale: Hebrew idiom 'throw my words behind you' = disregard; Tok Pisin 'go harim bilong yu' keeps the body-part picture

notes.subject: skulim
notes.rationale: מוסר is chastisement/discipline; Tok Pisin uses one word 'skulim' for the whole range

notes.subject: to ol man nogut
notes.rationale: direct address continuing from v.16, God rebuking the wicked

translation: Gutpela as bilong: yu les long skulim, na yu rausim ol tok bilong mi go harim bilong yu.
